description: Source code for a Git credential helper that interacts with macOS Keychain to store, retrieve, and delete credentials using Security framework APIs.

methods.name: clear_credential
methods.description: Releases and nullifies stored credential CF references.

methods.name: create_dictionary
methods.description: Creates a mutable CFDictionary with variable key-value pairs.

methods.name: write_item
methods.description: Outputs a key-value pair to stdout.

methods.name: write_item_strbuf
methods.description: Appends a key-value pair to a strbuf.

methods.name: write_item_strbuf_cfstring
methods.description: Appends a CFStringRef value to a strbuf.

methods.name: write_item_strbuf_cfnumber
methods.description: Appends a CFNumberRef value to a strbuf.

methods.name: write_item_strbuf_cfdata
methods.description: Appends a CFDataRef value to a strbuf.

methods.name: encode_state_seen
methods.description: Encodes credential state into a strbuf.

methods.name: find_username_in_item
methods.description: Extracts username from a CFDictionaryRef item.

methods.name: find_internet_password
methods.description: Retrieves password and username from Keychain.

methods.name: delete_internet_password
methods.description: Deletes credentials matching protocol and host.

methods.name: read_credential
methods.description: Reads credential input from stdin and parses it.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point; processes command line args to get/store/erase credentials.
